title: Onboarding: Fallback Companion Cards + Rescue Ribbon UX Kit
creator: Lin Chen
summary: Create a compact, brand-aligned asset pack (cards, ribbons, microcopy, and annotated screenshots) that explains rate limits, timeouts, and retry behavior in the quickstart flow with accessible visuals and small-screen variants.
description: Problem: New users hit transient rate limits and timeouts during the quickstart flow and abandon the onboarding because the current error screens are verbose and buried in a separate docs page. We need an inline, low-friction set of visuals and microcopy that: 1) informs users why a request failed (rate limit / timeout / retry), 2) shows immediate remedial steps (retry, switch region, reduce tokens), and 3) links to deeper troubleshooting guides. Scope: UX asset pack for quickstart modal, compact inline companion cards, a 320px-wide mobile ribbon ("rescue ribbon"), annotated full-screen screenshots for docs, and brief alt-text / localization notes.
designer_notes: Design language should follow the new Console tokens (shadow-2, accent-600), use the compact card layout to minimize vertical space, and include a single action primary button and a tertiary "Learn more" link. For rate limit visuals prefer an "energy meter" metaphor (green→amber→red) rather than a stop sign. For timeouts, show a subtle progress spoke + suggested timeout tuning line. For retries, illustrate exponential backoff with 3 dots and a small clock icon. All icons should be 12–16px and single-color (inherit). Export PNG/SVG and a low-resolution GIF demonstrating retry animation.
